newsitem.title: USA: Orbital Engine says to power Indonesia car.
newsitem.headline: Orbital Engine says to power Indonesia car.

text.p: Orbital Engine Corp Ltd said on Thursday its combustion process engine had been selected to power the planned Indonesian national car.
The company said its Orbital Combustion Process Engine had been selected by an Indonesian government group for use in the so-called Maleo project.
Orbital Engine declined to comment on revenue potential but said it would receive royalties for each engine used, and from engineering support.
Indonesia Research and Technology Minister Jusuf Habibie told an Indonesian parliamentary hearing that Orbital's engine had been selected, Orbital said.
Habibie's passenger car, which was set for production in 1998, was the second Indonesian national car design.
In February, Indonesia gave special tax and tariff breaks to PT Putra Timor Nasional to make a national car in partnership with South Korea's Kia Motors Corp.
Orbital Engine said it had been working with the Maleo team and government officials since mid-1995.
The Maleo car would meet Indonesia's domestic and export certification requirements, the company said.
